Install native agent hooks that call `lm-resizer hook`

Usage: lm-resizer init-native-hooks [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --client <CLIENT>            Agent: codex, claude, gemini, copilot, cursor, or all (codex + claude) [default: all]
      --project-dir <PROJECT_DIR>  Project directory where native hook config will be written
      --force                      Overwrite existing native hook config files
      --json                       Emit machine-readable JSON
  -h, --help                       Print help

Install lm-resizer as an MCP server for common agent clients

Usage: lm-resizer install [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --client <CLIENT>            Client to configure: claude, codex, cursor, vscode, all [default: claude]
      --scope <SCOPE>              Installation scope: project or global. Codex is user-scoped: `--client codex` requires `--scope global`, and `--client all` writes Codex to `~/.codex/config.toml` even with `project` [default: project]
      --project-dir <PROJECT_DIR>  Project directory for project-scoped config files
      --store <STORE>              CCR SQLite database path passed to the MCP server
  -h, --help                       Print help
